# Kurtis Lam - Portfolio & Projects

> Kurtis Lam is a student, developer, and speed typer specializing in web application development, utilities, and Discord tools.

## Overview
Kurtis Lam (born October 22, 2010) builds web applications, study tools, interactive web games, and mathematical utilities.

## Main Projects
- [GTEYC 2627 SU (Aurora)](https://gtcsu-aurora.web.app): Official webpage for GTEYC 2627 SU.
- [SVT Match](https://svt-match.web.app): A web-based game featuring leaderboards, shops, and social features.
- [kTown](https://ktown-45.web.app): An IB study and productivity web app featuring notes and citation tools.
- [DropSpot](https://dropspot-0.web.app): Lightweight peer-to-peer data and file transfer utility.
- [Colordle Solver](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/colordle-solver): A color match tool that solves Colordle using CIEDE2000 ($\Delta E_{00}$) calculations in CIE Lab space.
- [Kahoot Hack](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/kahoot-hack): A Chrome extension that reads Kahoot! questions, asks an AI model through OpenRouter, and highlights or auto-clicks the answer. Educational project; includes a step-by-step setup guide.
- [Monkeytyper](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/monkeytyper): Two Python scripts that automate Monkeytype, one using Selenium DOM queries and one using OpenCV + Tesseract OCR with PyAutoGUI. Educational project; includes a step-by-step setup guide.
- [fluxbg](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/fluxbg): An Android wallpaper app for Huawei phones. Add a static image or a dynamic video, crop it, trim videos on a timeline, and set it as the home and/or lock screen wallpaper. Source: https://github.com/Kurtis-Lam/fluxbg
- [Kurt](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/kurt): A terminal coding assistant that runs free open-source Hugging Face models locally through Ollama, with diffs and confirmation before every edit. Source: https://github.com/Kurtis-Lam/kurt

## Pages
- [Portfolio Homepage](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/): Main portfolio showcasing projects, live age counter, and active profiles.
- [Colordle Solver](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/colordle-solver): Live utility for estimating mystery colors using primary similarities.
- [Kahoot Hack](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/kahoot-hack): What the extension is, how it works, and how to install and use it.
- [Monkeytyper](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/monkeytyper): What the two scripts are, how they differ, and how to set up and run them.
- [fluxbg](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/fluxbg): What the app does, how to get the APK, build it, and use it.
- [Kurt](https://kurtis-lam.web.app/kurt): What the CLI is, how to install it on macOS and Windows, commands, and troubleshooting.
